description: Ask one question on your local Ollama server; returns one answer

parameter.label: Question
parameter.description: One question, no tools or history. Optional Context is data, not instructions.

parameter.label: Context
parameter.description: Optional facts; max 8,000 characters within the 20,000-character question limit.

default.name: Answer
default.description: The final answer as text; JSON mode still returns text

details.name: Run details
details.description: Model, token counts, wall time and server durations; no prompt or thinking trace

timeout.label: Stop after (seconds)
timeout.description: Includes loading and waiting. A timeout stops waiting; no automatic retry.

reply_json.label: Reply as JSON
reply_json.description: Returns JSON text. Use Check reply for expected fields.

thinking.label: Thinking
thinking.description: Off by default. Only the final answer is returned.

num_ctx.label: Context window (tokens)
num_ctx.description: Larger windows use more memory. Character caps do not guarantee token fit.
